field.name: kitCostFromComponents
field.description: Y: a pick-assembly kit made at pack (produce#AvailableAssemblies, for every caller) is received at the cost of the component issuances it uses (each issuance's quantity times its asset's acquireCost), divided by the kit quantity at the four decimals acquireCost keeps, a remainder received apart on its own unit, so the components leave work in process exactly and the kit's issue posts its cost of goods sold. N, the default: the kit is received with no cost, as before (AtrNoAcquireCost).

field.name: maxWeight
field.description: The most a package of this type carries, in its weightUomId; packing above it warns.

field.name: thruDate
field.description: When the type was retired: no new package takes it, and the packages that have it keep it.
